pipeline.modality: Inhaled small molecule kinase inhibitor (dry powder inhaler)
pipeline.license_origin: Internal (Gossamer Bio); ex-US partnership with Chiesi Farmaceutici

indications.indication: Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH), WHO Functional Class II/III
indications.highest_phase: Phase 3 (topline results reported Feb 2026 — primary endpoint not met at prespecified alpha; CTD-APAH subgroup positive)
indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, global registrational Phase 3 (n=390; 197 seralutinib / 193 placebo); 24-week 6MWD primary endpoint
indications.trial_status: COMPLETED (topline Feb 23 2026: +13.3 m placebo-adjusted 6MWD, p=0.0320, did not meet alpha=0.025; CTD-APAH subgroup +37.0 m, p=0.0104)
indications.lead_sponsor: GB002, Inc. (wholly owned subsidiary of Gossamer Bio)

indications.indication: Pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD)
indications.trial_status: SUSPENDED (start 2026-02; current ctgov status SUSPENDED — likely pending PROSERA data review)
